arguments.literal: source-owned method law
bounded operation is activated

include current subject and known material dependencies; a rule packet without its subject, an inaccessible digest or an unsupported stale summary is insufficient; partial projection, sparse checkout and an empty record prove no authoritative absence; acquire the owner or retain indeterminacy; exclude irrelevant content unless needed to establish irrelevance; decomposition cannot drop material outer obligations to meet capacity
source-owned method law
any fixed or adaptive allocation or reconfiguration is selected

every allocation preserves material dependencies, outstanding obligations, observed and uncertain effects, admitted authority and required independence; functional, communication, authority and evaluation dependencies are distinct; no unique topology follows from capacity; an optimality claim states objective, constraints, comparison scope and evidence
source-owned method law
an obligation is excluded as not applicable
unknown applicability or missing evaluation is not false applicability

a contribution is used to discharge an obligation
unauthenticated evidence discharges nothing; missing planned judgment and uncovered responsibility outside a plan are different
source-owned method law
composite subject or governing basis cannot be interpreted

declare once whether each relation is an admission condition or required material join; failed admission prevents interpretation while a false join falsifies an admitted conjunction; retain component failure without falsely assigning the invalid aggregate scope. The aggregate evaluation has performance performed when its combining rule is applied; this does not change component performance.
textual interpretation of source-owned shared law
source-owned method law
sequential operations compose, results are regrouped or operations are reordered

Sequential composition records an unreturned dependent evaluation as an absent
slot, retaining its observed performance, extent and missing conclusion. A lawful regrouping requires the same interpretable composite basis, required
leaf predicates, joins, normalized effect parts and authentication, with no intermediate basis failure
hidden by the grouping. On that fixed domain, retained component sets combine
by union, the conjunction precedence is associative, and the effect join over
normalized disjoint parts is associative. This grants no associativity to an
arbitrary declared operator; regrouping it requires preservation of the same
outer predicate and its own demonstrated associativity law. An invalid
intermediate join is a failed premise of that rewrite, not evidence that every
arbitrary grouping is equivalent. Reordering
operations additionally needs an effect-independence law; associativity alone
supplies no such permission.
source-owned method law
composite predicate/basis is interpretable and a required applicable predicate or material join is authentically falsified

an invalid contribution cannot erase an independently authenticated failure. The aggregate evaluation has performance performed when its combining rule is applied; this does not change component performance.
source-owned method law
interpretable composite has no authenticated applicable falsification

An empty list proves nothing unless the declared required set is established as empty. The aggregate evaluation has performance performed when its combining rule is applied; this does not change component performance.
textual interpretation of source-owned shared law
source-owned method law
private context is discarded or process resumes
private context loss creates no authority or idempotence guarantee; full-history replay is not universal; sufficient surviving sources can support resumption without every activation transcript
additional domain policy
the consumer adopts and lawfully activates the optional task-based Executive arrangement
this is additional profile policy, not core topology or authority; configuration preservation applies to every arrangement independently of this optional Executive
source-owned method law
a decision or stop is reported

a stop is indeterminate when undecided, falsified on admissible defeating evidence, or the established scope/basis diagnosis; lawfulness of stopping is a separate decision predicate and cannot claim product completion; a lawful rejection can satisfy its decision predicate without establishing candidate fitness
source-owned method law
observations combine over a declared composite effect scope

Conflicting or insufficient observations leave the part unknown. Retained ordering is not itself a selection or supersession rule. Temporal stage labels are not joined until mapped to the observed state of each part at the composite boundary.
source-owned method law
an effect observation is reported
These source conditions apply to every material possible part, including an unintended part of a nominally read-only operation; the effect observation is independent of the predicate verdict.
textual interpretation of source-owned shared law
source-owned method law
material state may change between observation and effect
reobserve, compare revision or use protected snapshot as bound by the operation; no universal isolation implementation
source-owned method law
required checking and acceptance are allocated
fresh context and role names do not establish independent authorship or authority
source-owned method law
a logical operator combines results

Authentic truth or falsity decides the declared outer predicate only after wellformedness is established; otherwise material deciding dependencies retain invalid_basis then out_of_frame then indeterminate; retain failed leaves and never pass negation, disjunction or fallback off as conjunction. The aggregate evaluation has performance performed when its combining rule is applied; this does not change component performance.
source-owned method law
a result is originated, reported, projected or consumed

retain observed extent, interruption and conclusion separately; an absent return establishes neither nonperformance nor an inconclusive evaluation; missing judgments remain coverage slots; a precondition is evidence unless separately required by the plan; an admission predicate cannot silently replace the downstream predicate. Dispatch or admission alone does not establish performance. The aggregate evaluation has performance performed when its combining rule is applied; this does not change component performance.
source-owned method law
A-to-Z work is decomposed into bounded transitions
purpose, identity, compatibility and assurance are extra premises; finite capacity does not derive them
source-owned method law
a core result is originated, reported, projected or consumed

possible enum pairs are not automatic admissibility; performance describes what evidence establishes, not an unobserved world fact; preserve extent, interruption, conclusion and all effect coordinates. Dispatch or admission alone does not establish performance.
source-owned method law
candidate_ready or an acceptance/yield decision is reported
availability is not fitness; lawful yield is not product completion; decision recording is not a grant

source-owned method law
progress or completion is claimed

counts are not a distance metric; Intent, Product and Specification refine Z under their owning authority; changing Z follows that owner and proves no old-destination completion; failed retry requires a supported causal change
source-owned method law
domain outcome is reported

Admissible new evidence does not rewrite the original qualified outcome or observed performance. A separate performed positive evaluation retains its own record and deciding support under the legal-pair rule; an unconfirmed original is not promoted to satisfied.
source-owned method law
a result is reported

every result projection preserves these coordinates and the original predicate; references preserve meaning and availability; no mandatory serialization or extra work carrier; a new result over a different predicate never overwrites the earlier result
source-owned method law
a stored result is reused
preserve demonstrably independent work; widen inspection when independence is unproved; stored green status alone is not validity
source-owned method law
an operation with uncertain effects may be repeated
partial persistent progress implies no universal idempotence; logs have only their declared domain role
source-owned method law
a total control contract is declared or any admitted control state is encountered
repair, re-entry, refusal, yield or termination stays within the actual grant; total control promises neither external termination, omniscience nor a solution to every world problem
source-owned method law
predicate is evaluated
the value is relative to this predicate; equal spelling across domains is not equal meaning
source-owned method law
admissible contrary current observations challenge retained beliefs
observations do not silently replace a frozen basis or rewrite governing requirements; reality and intended constraints remain distinct
